reason: Joining costs nothing and slow months hurt, so I would sign up and try one job to see if the customers are real. But 10% off every order is a big bite out of a tint or film job that already has thin margins.
objection: The 10% commission on top of my own costs. I have to know whether the job still pays me properly after it is taken.
would_change_my_mind: A lower commission, or proof from other shops that the requests actually turn into paid jobs in Riyadh.
